# HYGOAL

> HYGOAL is a precision machine components manufacturer based in Ningbo, Zhejiang, China (founded 2009), specializing in indexing plungers, leveling feet, cam levers, and custom CNC-machined parts for overseas customers. 15+ years of manufacturing, 1200+ SKUs, exports to 40+ countries, 98% on-time delivery.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.hygoal.com/): Company overview, product categories, factory capabilities.
- [Products](https://www.hygoal.com/products): Full product range, filterable by category (Indexing Plunger / Leveling Feet / Cam Lever / Customized Service).
- [About](https://www.hygoal.com/about): Why choose HYGOAL — precision craftsmanship, cost-effective manufacturing, OEM/ODM capability.
- [Contact](https://www.hygoal.com/contact): Request a quotation; engineers reply within 48 hours.

## Product categories

- **Indexing Plunger** — Indexing plungers with knob, pull ring or ball handle — steel and full stainless steel.
- **Leveling Feet** — Leveling mounts with tapped socket or rubber pad, in metric and inch sizes.
- **Cam Lever** — Cam levers with stud or internal thread, adjustable nut, in metric and inch.
- **Customized Service** — OEM / ODM customized components manufactured to your specific requirements.
